# Firebase Remote Config Basics

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — manages Firebase Remote Config templates, feature flags, loading strategies, and SDK setup for Android and iOS: downloading and deploying `remoteconfig` JSON templates via CLI, version history, in-app defaults, `fetchAndActivate()`, real-time listeners, platform setup guides, and fetch strategies (load-new-for-next-startup vs real-time) — with a mandatory user-review stop before deploying template changes. Nothing comparable exists in the catalog. Requires a Google account with Firebase enabled; Remote Config usage is billed on Google's paid tiers beyond the free allowance — a paid service for real projects. By @firebase, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
